Repository description: "The missing linter and lsp for AI coding assistants. Validate CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, hooks, MCP. Plugin for all major IDEs included, with autofixes.". Survived the landscape-sweep-20261009-api facts refuter and both fit refuters (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6-Astra); no native install, run or comparison with a winner.

documentation_excerpts.text: > Running open models for your company? [**Tiyuvta**](https://tiyuvta.ai/services/) helps with model choice, deployment and optimization, and fine-tuning on your hardware or cloud account.

**Your skills don't trigger.** Vercel's research found skills [invoke at 0%](https://vercel.com/blog/agents-md-outperforms-skills-in-our-agent-evals) without correct syntax. One wrong field and your skill is invisible.
**"Almost right" is the worst outcome.** [66% of developers](https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2025/ai) cite it as their biggest AI frustration. Misconfigured agents produce exactly this.
